hypotheses.justification: The theorem takes this instance because `N` and `q` are arguments, but nothing in the statement or the proof needs it. The structure `PlaceSpecialization A q N data hKr k red hα hβ` (Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_PlaceSpecialization.lean) only requires `[Fact q.Prime] [NeZero N] [Field k] [CharP k q]`. `PlaceSpecialization.fstDiv` (Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_GlueData.lean) is declared under a `variable` block that contains no coprimality assumption, and it is defined as `D.filter P.IsStrictFst`. The statement is a purely formal additivity property of `Finsupp.filter`, so it holds for every `q` and `N`. The proof goes through unchanged without `hqN`. The empty case uses `Finsupp.filter_zero`. The insert case uses `Finset.sum_insert` and `fstDiv_add`, whose own proof is just `unfold fstDiv; exact Finsupp.filter_add`. If the local `fstDiv_add` still carries the instance, that step can be replaced by `Finsupp.filter_add` after unfolding `fstDiv`. So `omit hqN in` on this theorem leaves it true and provable.
